Dear Mentors

Title: Interactive Teaching tool for Financial Derivatives
Link id: santosh_sssihl

Further to my proposal (title mentioned above), i have done some preliminary work on the project. 

I have implemented 3 functions as of now- 


1) A Present value calculation 
2) A Bond price calculation 
3) Bond price- maturity relationship depicted in an interactive plot with sliders to choose coupon rate and discount rate.


Please see screenshots and attached code.

Note: 
1) The above implementation is for demo alone- for proof of concept. i will replace my own functions with functions in R packages in the course of the project. 
2) The same was tested only on R 2.12.0. Packages required are mentioned on top of the attached r file (basically rpanel, tcltk, tcltk2, tkrplot etc). 

Awaiting your feedback 


Santosh Sridhar
